summary: Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd (NASDAQ: TDTH) filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval at its extraordinary general meeting of a multi-step capital restructuring: share redesignation of authorized but unissued Class A and Class C shares into blank shares, an increase in authorized share capital from US$50,000 to US$1,200,000, a 240-for-1 share consolidation, and adoption of amended articles. The restructuring provides headroom for future issuances and follows termination of the ADS program. No acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is involved; this is an internally driven reorganization.
